From MCP integrations with LLM providers to enterprise marketplace listings to partner-built connectors on Gamma's API, you'll shape how Gamma's design intelligence shows up across the tools hundreds of millions of people use daily. This role combines hands-on solution building, enterprise customer work, and partner enablement. You'll work directly with enterprise AI transformation leaders deploying Gamma for use cases like automated proposal generation from CRM data, and with platform partners like Atlassian, Glean, and HeyGen who are building Gamma into their own products. For every integration Gamma builds internally, the goal is an ecosystem of partners building many more on top of the API. You'll work closely with engineering, product, sales, and customer success to ensure our integrations are reliable, well-documented, and genuinely useful, and to shape the API product roadmap based on what you learn from partners and customers. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in New York. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. You build working solutions yourself, not just spec them - Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, translating business workflows into working integrations, not just architecture diagrams - Strong technical communication: you can debug a partner's code on a call, lead an architecture discussion with an enterprise IT team, and write documentation that developers actually use - Proactive and self-directed, with comfort operating in ambiguity. ghj-ghj:lever:c061f1bf-d972-4eed-9263-9d.description: GHJ Search and Staffing serves as the recruitment division of GHJ, a prominent national accounting and advisory firm. Our team provides qualified Accounting and Finance professionals on a temporary and permanent basis across a broad range of industries. GHJ’s relationship with our Global Advisory and Accounting Network provides the resources needed to better understand client’s needs, attract a higher caliber of candidates and assess candidate potential. We are seeking a mission-driven Controller to oversee the financial & accounting operations of a highly-respected nonprofit organization in Atlanta, GA. The Controller is responsible for overseeing the financial operations of the nonprofit organization, including accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, compliance, internal controls, and audit coordination. This role ensures the accuracy and integrity of financial records while supporting the organization’s mission through sound financial management and strategic guidance. The Controller manages day-to-day accounting functions and helps ensure compliance with nonprofit accounting standards and applicable laws and regulations.
responsibilities: Financial Management & Accounting
Oversee all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and cash management.
Prepare timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Maintain the integrity of the organization’s financial records and accounting systems.
Ensure compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and nonprofit accounting standards.
Monitor and reconcile bank accounts and investment activity.
Budgeting & Financial Planning
Assist with the development and management of the annual operating budget.
Provide budget-to-actual variance analysis and financial forecasting.
Support leadership with financial analysis and recommendations.
Collaborate with department leaders to monitor program and grant budgets.
Audit & Internal Controls
Coordinate annual financial audits and tax filings, including Form 990 preparation support.
Develop and maintain effective internal controls and financial policies.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Leadership & Administration
Supervise and mentor accounting and finance staff, as applicable.
Serve as a financial resource to leadership and program managers.
Participate in strategic planning and organizational initiatives.
Support board and finance committee reporting requirements.
qualifications: 5+ years of accounting or finance experience preferably within the nonprofit space
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field

Our partner is looking for a Director of Finance & Business Performance based in Canada. You will take ownership of core financial operations while strengthening cash management, payroll, reporting, controls, and compliance. Beyond traditional finance responsibilities, you will turn financial data into practical insights that guide business decisions and improve performance. wattpad-wattpad:lever:ddc94b03-484b-4c17.title: [WEBTOON] Project Manager - D Comics
wattpad-wattpad:lever:ddc94b03-484b-4c17.description: WEBTOON Entertainment is a leading global entertainment company and home to some of the world's largest storytelling platforms. As the global leader and pioneer of the mobile webcomic format, WEBTOON Entertainment has transformed comics and visual storytelling for fans and creators. With its CANVAS UGC platform empowering anyone to become a creator, and a growing roster of superstar WEBTOON Originals creators and series, WEBTOON Entertainment’s passionate fandoms are the new face of pop culture. WEBTOON Entertainment adaptations are available on Netflix, Prime Video, Crunchyroll, and other screens around the world, and the company’s content partners include Discord, HYBE, and DC Comics, among many others. WEBTOON is becoming the home for Marvel and Disney comics — a new subscription app where fans read, collect, and stay connected to the stories and characters they love. We're building the definitive destination for Marvel/Disney IP, and we're looking for a Project Manager to keep it on track. This role reports to the Head of Marketing and is the connective tissue across the team — owning schedules, driving deliverables to completion, and making sure the right work is approved by the right people at the right time. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, calm under pressure, and comfortable being hands-on in a lean, fast-moving environment. It's an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on bringing order to ambiguity, enjoys keeping cross-functional teams aligned, and is passionate about entertainment, fandom, and culture.
responsibilities: Own and maintain project schedules across marketing, creative, and partner workstreams — tracking milestones, dependencies, and deadlines, and flagging risks before they become problems.
Route creative and marketing assets through review and approval — coordinating feedback across internal stakeholders and Marvel/Disney partners, and tracking versions and sign-offs.
Drive deliverables to completion, holding internal teams, agencies, and partners accountable to timelines and keeping every workstream moving.
Run the operating rhythm of the team — organizing meetings, capturing action items, and following up to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
Serve as the central point of coordination across the team, staying on top of who owes what and proactively unblocking work as launch priorities shift.
qualifications: 5+ years of project or program management experience, ideally within entertainment, media, or a marketing/creative environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills, with a sharp eye for detail and deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to drive accountability and influence teams without direct authority.
Experience coordinating asset review and approval processes across internal teams and external partners.
Comfort with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Asana, Monday, Jira, or similar).
Highly adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and a dynamic work environment.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Korean is a plus.
